title: Please add the following epidemiology applications, thank you!
description:
BiasLab (Quantitative Bias Analysis)
Viti Science
A tool that lets researchers quantify and visualize the impact of common biases in pharmacoepidemiology, such as outcome misclassification, unmeasured confounding, and selection bias, through interactive, transparent sensitivity analyses.
https://vitiscience.shinyapps.io/BiasLab/

ShinyEpiSheet (Episheet reimagined)
Viti Science
A tool for transparent, no-code, summary-level epidemiologic data analyses that lets researchers stratify and standardize risks and rates, compute exact confidence intervals and power, and export visuals.
https://vitiscience.shinyapps.io/ShinyEpiSheet/

RSVSafeStart (prediction model)
Viti Science
An interactive  tool that operationalizes a validated model for predicting infant respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) hospitalization risk, using plain-language inputs and real-time estimates to inform patients, healthcare providers, and policymakers.
https://vitiscience.shinyapps.io/RSVSafeStart/

title: App addition request: PRS Explorer
description:
Hello,

I would like to request the addition of my application, PRS Explorer, to your showcase.

* **App Name:** PRS Explorer
* **Live App URL:** https://barreiro-r.shinyapps.io/prs-explorer/
* **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/barreiro-r/prs-explorer

PRS Explorer is an interactive web application built with R and Shiny. It allows users to explore and visualize polygenic risk scores (PRS), a method used for risk categorization based on genomic data. The app aims to make PRS concepts more accessible and understandable.

Thank you for your consideration!

title: Pharma category app
description:
